title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.8.14
body_markdown:
*released September 10th, 2024*

### What's New in this release

* Updating authentication method used when interacting with the Microsoft Store.

### Developer Community

* [Fix non-deterministic generation of exit thunks for memcpy on ARM64EC](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Internal-Backport-Request/10693433)

### Security advisories addressed

[**CVE-2024-35272**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-35272) SQL Server Native Client OLE DB Provider Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
